name: Eye Of Faith
introduce:
ROG-FE01 信仰之眼
著名硬件制造商ROG与卡玛达联合开发的重型机兵。在外形设计上采用了ROG系列一贯的前沿潮流风格，并配备了多处炫酷的发光光带。机兵内部则采用了来自卡玛达的成熟方案，业界领先的传动系统与岚合金框架，让信仰之眼在长线战斗中独占鳌头。

20484.name: Overlimit Frame
20484.SpecificEffects: When possessing temporary HP, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>

30378.name: Overlimit Mod
30378.SpecificEffects:
When receiving healing effects, excess repair amount will temporarily increase the maximum HP, up to <color=#F74848>24%</color>.
When attacked in combat, if posesses temporary HP, can trigger <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf>.

20482.name: Flow Generator
20482.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking or counterattacking, restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>15%</color> DMG dealt to all undestroyed part, and can restore <color=#F74848>1</color> part.
